definitionZh: :heading () CSS 伪类函数代表所有与逗号分隔的整数列表相匹配的标题元素. 这使得您可以同时在特定标题级别上样式元素,而不是单独匹配和样式.
sourceDefinition: The :heading() CSS pseudo-class function represents all heading elements whose levels match a comma-separated list of integers. This allows you to style elements at specific heading levels at once, rather than matching and styling them individually.
